violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Observed excessive build up on the containers in the dry storage area. Observed excessive build up on the shelves in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean the dry storage area and walk in cooler prior to the next inspection

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CUT CABBAGE ON PREP TABLE OBSERVED AT 56F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM WILL USE TPHC 4 HOURS MOVING FORWARD. CFM MARKED CUT CABBAGE WITH END TIME OF 4:00PM. CFM AND EHS WILL UPDATE TPHC LIST OF FOODS.

violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE PLACE ALL WET WIPING CLOTHS IN BLEACH SANITIZER SOLUTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed sheet pan of raw chicken stored on shelf above cooked chicken in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved raw chicken to bottom shelf. CFM reviewed with staff proper storage order of food in units to prevent potential cross contamination.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: observed cooked sweet and sour chicken in 2 DR UC prepared on Wednesday (>24 hours).
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM labelled container with prepared date. EHS reviewed with CFM that any prepared foods kept for more than 24 hours must be date marked and used within 7 days of preparation.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottle of cleaner underneath cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM labelled spray bottle with cleaner name.

violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloth on countertop of 2 DR UC.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM prepared container of sanitizer and will store wet wiping cloths in bleach sanitizer solution.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops in container of water on counter top.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM removed rice spoons and utensils from container of water. CFM will store rice utensils dry.
